strings.You're now the head coach of your very o: You're now the head coach of your very own college water polo program. Let's take a quick tour!

strings.The %d tournament champions and the %d h: The %d tournament champions and the %d highest-ranked other teams in the final National Top 20 poll make the %d-team NCSA Championship.
strings.The field is seeded by that poll; seeds: The field is seeded by that poll; seeds 1-4 skip the first round.

strings.The playoffs start after the regular sea: The playoffs start after the regular season. Every team plays its conference tournament; then %d teams play for the NCSA Championship.
strings.The NCSA Championship field is set after: The NCSA Championship field is set after the conference finals: the %d conference champions and the best-ranked teams in the final Top 20 poll, %d in all.
strings.YOUR CONFERENCE TOURNAMENT RUN HAS COME: YOUR CONFERENCE TOURNAMENT RUN HAS COME TO AN END, BUT YOUR SEASON ISN'T OVER YET! YOU'VE EARNED A SPOT IN THE NCSA TOURNAMENT, AND THERE'S STILL A CHANCE TO COMPETE FOR THE NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP!
strings.Use the shooting stick at the bottom lef: Use the shooting stick at the bottom left: put your finger on it, drag the knob back for power, up to aim low or down to aim high, and let go to shoot. A full pull is the hardest shot but the least accurate. It's the only way to shoot.
strings.Tap anywhere in the water to pass there:: Tap anywhere in the water to pass there: on a teammate, or into open water ahead of him to lead his run. A pass through a defender can be picked off.
strings.Tap DRIVE, on top of the shooting stick,: Tap DRIVE, on top of the shooting stick, and pick LEFT, MIDDLE or RIGHT: that player swims hard at the goal. Hit him in stride.
strings.Your field players mark their men by the: Your field players mark their men by themselves, pick off passes and strip a man who holds the ball too long. The bar at the bottom switches between PRESS and the drop you picked in COACHING.
strings.When they shoot, tap high or low and you: When they shoot, tap high or low and your keeper dives that way. Time it: he's only at full stretch for a moment (longer with strong legs), so too early and he's back down, too late and it's past him.
strings.Every quarter starts with a sprint for t: Every quarter starts with a sprint for the ball: tap as fast as you can.
strings.You have 30 seconds to shoot. The last f: You have 30 seconds to shoot. The last five count down in red.
strings.Feed your center on 2 m and he draws fou: Feed your center on 2 m and he draws fouls: an exclusion sends a defender out for 20 seconds and you play 6 on 5. A player with three personal fouls is out for the game and a sub comes in.
strings.Fouled from behind in a scoring position: Fouled from behind in a scoring position inside 5 m and you get a penalty shot. A free throw inside 6 m has to be a pass.
strings.In COACHING, PICK YOUR DEFENSE: M-DROP,: In COACHING, PICK YOUR DEFENSE: M-DROP, 4-5, 5 or 3-4. Every defence starts in your normal defence: tap CALL DROP and that drop's on for the rest of their possession (a 6 on 5 plays its own). You can change the drop once at halftime. A long spell in a drop tires the keeper's legs (less for strong legs): high shots get harder to reach. Theirs too, so work the ball against a drop.
strings.Field defenders get an arm up on shots b: Field defenders get an arm up on shots by themselves: the better their Defense, the more they block.
strings.EASY, MEDIUM, HARD or DYNAMIC, in Settin: EASY, MEDIUM, HARD or DYNAMIC, in Settings: how smart the other team plays, never anybody's ratings. DYNAMIC follows your last few games.
strings.Eight recruits are on the market, each w: Eight recruits are on the market, each with his own price in Polo Points. Sign up to four a season; they join next season as freshmen. The first REFRESH of a season is free, and every 2 games you play the market rolls new recruits for free (your pinned ones stay).
strings.Earned by winning: a regular-season win,: Earned by winning: a regular-season win, beating ranked teams, big wins and shutouts, streaks and titles, and every new season. Each dynasty has its own; purchased Polo Points work in every dynasty. Spent on recruits, refreshes and facilities.
strings.Players earn XP in games and in training: Players earn XP in games and in training. Each level brings an upgrade: one box on an attribute, never past his ceiling. Upgrades are spent before the next game.
strings.Pick a focus and an intensity each week:: Pick a focus and an intensity each week: harder work, more XP, more injury risk. RECOVERY heals every injury but gives no XP.
strings.C center, 2MD two-meter defender, ATK at: C center, 2MD two-meter defender, ATK attacker, WG wing, UT utility, LFTY a left-handed attacker. Your seven: C, 2MD, two ATK, two WG and a GK. A centre or 2MD plays the two posts (a utility may play 2MD too); attackers, wings and utilities the outside. A lefty plays the right side (ATK/LFTY, WG/LFTY): two at most start.
